newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures ends up ahead of tankan.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures ends up ahead of tankan.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures ended firmer on Tuesday ahead of Bank of Japan (BOJ)'s quarterly tankan report, dealers said.
Dealers said SIMEX Nikkei 225 December contract gapped up at the open at 21,465 against its Chicago close at 21,420.
"There is quite a bit of buying on dips. The charts look strong," a dealer said.
The contract later rallied to its day's high at 21,480 before easing back to end at 21,365, up 65 points from its SIMEX previous close. Turnover was 19,000 lots.
Dealers said activity was partly stymied by BOJ's tankan due for release on Wednesday and the U.S. Thanksgiving holiday on Thursday.
He added the next support for December was seen at 21,300, after which 21,170 was seen as strong base.
"If we can sustain the firmer levels in the near-term, the contract could test 21,500-21,550 shortly," the dealer said.
